description: The Municipality of Campodoro maintains a municipal update of the GeoTopographic Database (DBGT), originating in the Padova ETRA survey lot. Native lineage explicitly says that updates use public-works design projects, urban implementation plans and building projects from private-building files, alongside orthophotos and cadastral maps and records. These source-defined built-environment inputs establish the scope of the municipal update. The metadata does not establish which designs were constructed or the completeness of individual asset classes. The original regional database follows version 2.6 of the Veneto topographic-database specifications; those specifications and feature bodies were not read. Coverage is the municipal territory of Campodoro, Veneto, Italy. The native metadata date is 2023-03-27, not a verified date for every represented asset. Shapefile is named as the distribution format, with municipal cartographic and DBGT access pages. The metadata states no public-access limitation, marks access/use conditions unknown and separately names CC BY 4.0; these statements are retained without assuming uniform unrestricted use. File-use costs remain unknown. Building geometry, attribute schema, road connectivity, current condition and specific simulation uses are unverified. Other municipal DBGT updates share the original survey lot but have separate publishers and maintenance identities. No dataset, feature, map, design file or specification body was obtained.
